rules.summary: Chromium-family address and command bars with inline autocomplete

provenance.reason: Selected inline suggestion absorbs the first backspace: 'a'+'s' gives 'aá', 'd'+'d' gives 'dđ'.
provenance.notes: VERIFY that the omnibox is exposed to AX without enabling renderer accessibility; VERIFY Arc and Dia command bar roles. The tested entry is a placeholder until the scenario passes.

rules.summary: Safari address bar with inline autocomplete (WebKit exposes the selection through AX)

provenance.reason: The suggested remainder is selected after the caret and absorbs a backspace: VNI 'ca6u' gave 'caấu'.
provenance.notes: VERIFY the address field role and toolbar ancestor in Safari and Safari Technology Preview; VERIFY the 15 ms AXSelectedTextRange timeout. The tested entry is a placeholder until the scenario passes.

rules.summary: Firefox URL bar with inline autocomplete

provenance.reason: The URL bar selects the suggested remainder after the caret, so 'Có' gave 'Coó'.
provenance.notes: VERIFY Gecko AX availability without an assistive client and the URL bar role. The tested entry is a placeholder until the scenario passes.

rules.summary: Google Sheets cell autocomplete in Chromium browsers

provenance.reason: Column autocomplete selects the suggested remainder ('D'+'d' gives 'DĐức'); first letter lost when the cell enters edit mode.
provenance.notes: Requires AX document URL; without it this rule never matches. VERIFY firstEditDelayUs. axSelection only (decision of 2026-11-13, docs/decisions/0005-pa-decisions-2026-11-13.md): the zero-width placeholder returns only with an automated 1,000-edit test (PLT-R422); until then a suggestion that AX cannot read may stay in the cell (matrix note). The tested entry is a placeholder until the scenario passes.

rules.summary: Google Sheets cell autocomplete and edit-mode transition in Safari

provenance.reason: In Safari the first letter was lost while the cell was not yet in edit mode, and column autocomplete selected the suggested remainder.
provenance.notes: Requires AX document URL. VERIFY firstEditDelayUs and that WebKit exposes the cell editor selection. The tested entry is a placeholder until the scenario passes.

rules.summary: Telegram Web message composer: select the letters and type over them

provenance.reason: Telegram Web dropped the first Vietnamese letter of a message with backspace replacement; select-then-type avoided it in public reports.
provenance.notes: Requires AX document URL. VERIFY in Chrome and Safari, and that Shift+Left selects inside the composer. The tested entry is a placeholder until the scenario passes.

rules.summary: Chrome Remote Desktop web client forwards key codes, not text

provenance.reason: The web client sends key codes to the remote machine, so injected text arrives as wrong letters or not at all.
provenance.notes: Requires AX document URL. VERIFY the access URL prefix; advise typing Vietnamese with the remote machine's own input method. The tested entry is a placeholder until the scenario passes.

rules.summary: Excel cell editor with AutoComplete

provenance.reason: AutoComplete selects the suggested remainder in the cell editor ('D'+'d' gave 'DĐức'), and cell content was erased in public reports.
provenance.notes: VERIFY the cell editor's AX role. The sheet-tab rename editor needs its own rule (selectReplace or axReplace per test). axSelection only (decision of 2026-11-13, docs/decisions/0005-pa-decisions-2026-11-13.md): the zero-width placeholder returns only with an automated 1,000-edit test (PLT-R422); until then a suggestion that AX cannot read may stay in the cell (matrix note). The tested entry is a placeholder until the scenario passes.

rules.summary: Microsoft Office: backspace-only replacement with re-entry verification

provenance.reason: Outlook deleted the character after the caret and AutoCorrect rewrote words in public reports; edits stay backspace-only and re-entry is verified before a previous word is edited.
provenance.notes: The values equal the defaults for native apps on purpose and are pinned so a change of defaults cannot silently affect Office. VERIFY Office AX exposure and Word AutoComplete. The tested entry is a placeholder until the scenario passes.

rules.summary: LibreOffice: paced synthetic events so they are not reordered

provenance.reason: LibreOffice processes synthetic events asynchronously and reordered them: 'Nguyễn' gave 'Ngễuyn'.
provenance.notes: Initial pacing values are hypotheses. VERIFY in Writer and Calc. The tested entry is a placeholder until the scenario passes.

rules.summary: Electron apps: default strategy, never enable accessibility, no text-focus gating

provenance.reason: Electron web editors handle synthetic keys, but AX is unreliable until enabled and enabling it can switch VS Code into screen-reader mode.
provenance.notes: The values equal the engine defaults on purpose and are pinned. VERIFY the AXManualAccessibility side effects before any per-panel rule enables AX. The tested entry is a placeholder until the scenario passes.

rules.summary: VS Code and Cursor editors: engine code context

provenance.reason: Code editors need the engine's code context so words such as 'tar' or 'less' are restored instead of transformed.
provenance.notes: VERIFY Cursor's bundle ID; VERIFY burst typing in the editor. The tested entry is a placeholder until the scenario passes.

rules.summary: VS Code and Cursor integrated terminal: terminal pacing and code context

provenance.reason: The integrated terminal feeds keys to a shell like a terminal emulator, and users asked for terminal behaviour there instead of the editor's.
provenance.notes: VERIFY that the terminal's helper textarea class is exposed through AX without enabling AXManualAccessibility; otherwise this rule never matches and the editor rule applies. The tested entry is a placeholder until the scenario passes.

rules.summary: Terminal emulators: one key per read for TUIs, no auto-capitalisation

provenance.reason: TUIs (Claude Code, Kiro CLI) lost or appended letters when backspaces and UTF-8 arrived in one read.
provenance.notes: Initial pacing values are hypotheses. VERIFY with an Ink-based TUI, zsh-autosuggestions, tmux over ssh. Warp reports caret 0, so no AX gating. The tested entry is a placeholder until the scenario passes.

rules.summary: Java apps such as JetBrains IDEs: paced events, no AX gating, code context

provenance.reason: JetBrains IDEs duplicated vowels with unpaced events, and slow Java AX froze the prior art's main thread.
provenance.notes: Pacing values are hypotheses. VERIFY in the editor and the integrated terminal; the AX circuit breaker (PLT-R384) bounds slow AX. The tested entry is a placeholder until the scenario passes.

rules.summary: Editors with custom text views: no text-focus gating

provenance.reason: Custom text views may not expose an editable AX role, so whenKnown gating could pause typing in a working editor.
provenance.notes: A risk of this design rather than a reported symptom. VERIFY each editor's AX role; the menu offers a one-click override when typing pauses. The tested entry is a placeholder until the scenario passes.

rules.summary: Design and video apps where letters are tool shortcuts

provenance.reason: Telex double letters produced a backspace that deleted the selected shape when no text field had focus.
provenance.notes: VERIFY which apps expose an editable AX role while editing a text frame (consider requireTextFocus=always there); VERIFY the bundle ID of the unified Affinity app. The tested entry is a placeholder until the scenario passes.

rules.summary: Remote desktop, VM and iPhone Mirroring clients forward keycodes, not text

provenance.reason: Clients translate keycodes; injected text arrives as wrong letters ('a' for everything) or nothing.
provenance.notes: VERIFY bundle IDs (iPhone Mirroring, Windows App). Users may opt into the 'paste' strategy per app. The tested entry is a placeholder until the scenario passes.

rules.summary: Games read key codes for controls: pass keys through, start in English

provenance.reason: Games read key codes for their controls; transforming letters added input lag and changed controls.
provenance.notes: Word games are left out on purpose because they may need Vietnamese text. VERIFY with a keyboard-driven full-screen game. The tested entry is a placeholder until the scenario passes.

rules.summary: Spotlight: overlay panel with inline completion; Escape keeps closing it

provenance.reason: Spotlight is a non-activating panel with inline completion: 'books' gave 'boôooks' and 'cố' gave 'coố'.
provenance.notes: VERIFY on macOS 26 and 27, including the redesigned Spotlight field. The tested entry is a placeholder until the scenario passes.

rules.summary: Raycast and Alfred: overlay panels with their own focus and memory

provenance.reason: The panels take keyboard focus without becoming frontmost, so the remembered mode was ignored, and their search fields complete inline.
provenance.notes: VERIFY the bundle IDs (Alfred 5 and later) and whether either field shows a selected inline suggestion. The tested entry is a placeholder until the scenario passes.
